Clearer Messages." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_family:BebasNeueRegular" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3" heading_margin="margin-bottom:10px;"]Visual Storytelling for Government Employees: A Unique Training Workshop[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]In today's digital age, effective visual communication is crucial for government agencies to connect with their citizens. Storytelling with public policy data aids understanding and therefore, aids in the decision-making process.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]Government employees can utilize these techniques to analyze and interpret complex data, identifying patterns and trends that inform policy development. [/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-3" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14"][vc_tta_section title="Who is this workshop for?" tab_id="faq-govt-1-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Can it be delivered on site at a department?" tab_id="faq-govt-2-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes. On-site sessions are delivered at your offices; remote sessions run live on Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Webex, and a remote full day can be split over two mornings for teams across time zones. Workshops have been delivered across Australia, including Sydney and Canberra.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What does the team leave with?" tab_id="faq-govt-3-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

A repeatable process they can use the next day, plus the interactive workbook, 70 dashboard grid templates and 18 dashboard icons.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What does a government workshop cost?" tab_id="faq-govt-4-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

A private workshop costs between $4,600 and $7,500 inc GST depending on length and delivery format, and every price covers up to 12 attendees. The full rate card is on the workshop pricing page. Travel outside Melbourne is quoted up front rather than added afterwards.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Do you work with agencies outside Australia?" tab_id="faq-govt-5-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes. Workshops have been delivered in the United States, Germany, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong and Singapore, as well as across Australia.

Tell Me More About the Visual Storytelling for Government Workshop

[vc_column_text css=””]

This workshop provides you with all the tools and techniques you can use to lift out a data visualization story without losing any important information. Leave with a process you can immediately apply to any report or dataset that ensures your hard work is presented in the best way possible. Throughout the training, your confidence in design will build through guided exercises, putting the theory to practice in both data viz and storytelling. The Datalabs Agency is a Melbourne-based data visualization consultancy founded in 2012 that delivers corporate training workshops (Power BI, Tableau, data storytelling), dashboard design, and BI style guides for clients including Mercedes-Benz, Adidas, and UPS.

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/6″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][vc_column_text css=””]The workbook consists of classroom-style instruction, theory, examples, and hands-on exercises. More visuals. Less Text. Clearer Messages.

Visual Storytelling for Government Employees: A Unique Training Workshop

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]In today’s digital age, effective visual communication is crucial for government agencies to connect with their citizens. Visual storytelling and data visualization offer powerful tools to convey complex information in a compelling and accessible manner. Why shouldn’t government employees embrace these techniques to enhance transparency, engagement, and decision-making?

Visual storytelling is best at combining narratives with captivating visuals.[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]For government employees, incorporating new techniques in design will enhance their ability to communicate key messages effectively. By leveraging images, videos, infographics, and interactive content, they can present data-driven narratives that resonate with the public. Visual storytelling not only simplifies complex information but also humanizes government initiatives, making them more relatable and engaging for citizens.

Data visualization is an essential tool for promoting transparency within government agencies.[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]By presenting data in easily understandable visual formats, employees can foster trust and confidence in government initiatives. Clear and accessible data visualization empowers citizens to explore information, track progress, and make informed decisions. Government employees should strive to use interactive charts, maps, and dashboards (so-called new data viz) to present data in an engaging and user-friendly manner, ensuring transparency and fostering an environment of openness.

Storytelling with public policy data aids understanding and therefore, aids in the decision-making process.[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text css=””]Government employees can utilize these techniques to analyze and interpret complex data, identifying patterns and trends that inform policy development. Artificial intelligence (AI) like Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude can help. Visualizing data allows decision-makers to grasp insights quickly and make informed choices based on evidence. By presenting data-driven narratives, government agencies can inspire confidence in their decision-making processes and demonstrate accountability to the public.

It’s that simple. And it’s our hope that this workshop will move the dial of creative visual communications with data.[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” el_id=”pat-faq” css=”.vc_custom_1756412002{background-color: #171d2a !important;}”][/vc_row][/vc_row][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″]

Questions & Answers

[/vc_column_text]
[dfd_accordion style=”style-3″ active_section=”1″ font_size=”18″ tab_title_google_fonts=”yes” tab_title_custom_fonts=”font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal” icon_size=”14″][vc_tta_section title=”Who is this workshop for?” tab_id=”faq-govt-1-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

Public-sector teams who have to communicate with data — the people producing infographics, reports and PowerPoint decks for ministers, boards and the public. No design background is assumed.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can it be delivered on site at a department?” tab_id=”faq-govt-2-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

Yes. On-site sessions are delivered at your offices; remote sessions run live on Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Webex, and a remote full day can be split over two mornings for teams across time zones. Workshops have been delivered across Australia, including Sydney and Canberra.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What does the team leave with?” tab_id=”faq-govt-3-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

A repeatable process they can use the next day, plus the interactive workbook, 70 dashboard grid templates and 18 dashboard icons.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What does a government workshop cost?” tab_id=”faq-govt-4-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

A private workshop costs between $4,600 and $7,500 inc GST depending on length and delivery format, and every price covers up to 12 attendees. The full rate card is on the workshop pricing page. Travel outside Melbourne is quoted up front rather than added afterwards.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Do you work with agencies outside Australia?” tab_id=”faq-govt-5-2026″][vc_column_text css=””]

Yes. Workshops have been delivered in the United States, Germany, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong and Singapore, as well as across Australia.
